children: Scandinavian Enviro Systems obtained a waiver and approved a second SEK 5M drawdown under its convertible loan agreement, following an initial SEK 5M drawdown that was converted into shares. Disbursement is expected during week 45.
Second SEK 5M drawdown; prior drawdown was SEK 5M
Provides liquidity during the ongoing reorganisation, but adds convertible debt and continues reliance on this financing.
Conversion price: 95% of lowest 3 VWAPs in 10 days
The discount and market-price formula may create dilution; the conversion price is subject to a quota-value floor.
2.5M warrants planned; strike set at 150% of prior-day VWAP
The free warrants add potential dilution if exercised; their strike depends on the share price before the drawdown request.
First SEK 5M converted into 62.5M shares at SEK 0.08
Shows prior loan conversion resulted in a substantial share issuance; the second drawdown's dilution is not yet determinable.

This is a further financing step during the company's ongoing reorganisation, following a first drawdown and conversion announced in October 2026. The next catalysts are disbursement and any conversion or warrant-issue decisions, which would clarify timing and potential dilution.
